cloudStepChecking: Connecting to the environment and checking the runtime
environmentRepaired: Environment fixed; continuing with the earlier messages
sandboxReplaced: Preparing the environment failed; preparing it again
sandboxLost: The environment stopped answering and was replaced: work pushed and backed up at the end of each turn comes along, and changes made after that are gone
sandboxReleased: The environment was released after {minutes} minutes without activity. The next message starts a new one, and work pushed and backed up at the end of each turn comes along.
sandboxReleasedNoCredits: Credits ran out, so the environment was released. Once there are credits again, the next message starts a new one, and work pushed and backed up at the end of each turn comes along.
sandboxReleasedDiskFull: The machine's disk was nearly full and this environment held the most of it ({gb} GB, {files} files, mostly under {where}), so it was released. The next message starts a new one, and work pushed and backed up at the end of each turn comes along. Delete temporary files once you are done with them, so they do not pile up.
sandboxReleasedOverBudget: This environment held more of the disk than one environment may ({gb} GB, {files} files, mostly under {where}; the limit is {limit_gb} GB and {limit_files} files), so it was released. The next message starts a new one, and work pushed and backed up at the end of each turn comes along. Delete temporary files once you are done with them, so they do not pile up.
sandboxArchivesKept: Archives left by this conversation's earlier environments are kept until {date} and then deleted. To get files back from them, contact the platform administrator.
cloudVmReplaced: Preparing the VM sandbox failed; preparing it again
cloudVmReleasedIdle: The VM sandbox was idle for {minutes} minutes. Its changes were pushed to their branches and it was released; the next message prepares a new one.
cloudHostGivenUp: Cloud host {host} was given up: {lost} working sandboxes were lost with it, and {replaced} sandboxes being prepared moved to another host
